title: Direction Decision — Roadmap Direction Status Record
description: Formal record of every active, superseded, deferred, or deprecated direction in the Codex Factory roadmap. Prevents direction drift and ensures stale directions are explicitly retired.

status.description: active = current next phase; superseded = replaced by better direction; deferred = valid but prerequisites not met; deprecated = wrong/abandoned; completed = done

supersededBy.description: directionId of the direction that supersedes this one, if applicable

evidenceRefs.description: References to audit reports, claim audits, verification results

prerequisites.description: Prerequisites that must be met before this direction can become active (only for deferred status)

owner.description: Agent or human who made the decision

phase.description: Phase when this decision was made
